sections.title: What this module covers
sections.body: Action Controller is where Rails request handling lives, and interviewers go deep on three areas: callbacks (before_action execution order, skip_before_action, around_action), strong parameters (why they exist, how params.require.permit prevents mass assignment), and the render vs redirect_to distinction. This page covers all three plus sessions and cookies, respond_to format blocks, rescue_from for error handling, and controller concerns. The strong parameters question is a security question in disguise — interviewers want to know you understand that permit protects against overwriting attributes that should never be user-settable, not just that you know the API syntax.

sections.title: Key topics and depth markers
sections.body: Topics: callbacks-filters, strong-parameters, sessions-cookies, respond-to-render. Each topic has dedicated Q&A covering the concept, the comparison, the internal mechanics, and the scenario-based questions interviewers use to test production understanding.

sections.title: How interviewers probe this module
sections.body: Interviewers at Rails-focused companies probe these topics by opening with a definition question, then immediately following up with when would you use X vs Y? and what are the gotchas?. The depth marker is always the trade-off and the failure mode — not just the API surface.
